name: linux-v6.12-x86-64-kernel-audit
scope: Instruction availability for the pinned 64-bit kernel audit. Not a CPU baseline, ambient kernel code-generation mode or runtime capability guarantee.

rationale.popcnt: Retain the preceding C audit permission for kernel bit-population code.
rationale.rdrand: Retain the preceding C and assembly audit permission for random-number instruction forms.
rationale.rdtscp: Permit captured timestamp-reading C and assembly templates.
rationale.xsave: Permit captured XGETBV/XSAVE-family C templates; runtime state and CPU support remain caller obligations.
rationale.clflush: Permit captured cache-flush C templates and assembly.
rationale.fsgsbase: Permit captured FS/GS-base C templates and assembly.
rationale.prefetchw: Permit captured write-prefetch C templates and assembly.
rationale.invpcid: Permit captured PCID-invalidation C templates and assembly.
rationale.rdseed: Permit captured seed-reading C templates and assembly.
rationale.waitpkg: Permit captured TPAUSE C templates and retain the preceding assembly permission for wait-package forms.
